body: I don't think these should be in `EditorDebuggerSession`, which is just a class to expose debugger functionalities to scripting.

These are indeed functionalities of `ScriptEditorDebugger`. The game view is implemented as an `EditorDebuggerPlugin`, so I think `EditorDebuggerSession` is the intended way of accessing them.

These indirections can be worked around by calling `send_message()` directly. But I think we still need access to the corresponding `ScriptEditorDebugger` to keep its internal state in sync.

Maybe we can expose these? Or should I make the indirection via the `EditorDebuggerNode` singleton instead of via `EditorDebuggerSession`?
